% The math font of a document in Computer Modern, Latin Modern Math, with
% the PDF's alphabets, accents, and dots: \mathbb in AMS's msbm, \mathcal
% and its bold in cmsy's design, accents over the italic letters where TeX
% puts them, and dots spaced as TeX spaces them, also when \dots chooses
% them. Then the dots in a subscript, where TeX drops their thin spaces,
% and in a matrix.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\begin{document}
Alphabets: $\mathbb{R}$, $\mathcal{A}$, and $\boldsymbol{\mathcal{A}}$.

Accents: $\hat a$, $\hat x$, $\vec a$, and $\hat A$.

Dots: $1,2,\ldots,n$, $a+\cdots+b$, $1,\dots,n$, $a+\dots+b$, and
$x_{1,\ldots,n}$.
\[ \begin{pmatrix} 1 & \cdots & 0 \\ \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\ 0 & \cdots & 1 \end{pmatrix} \]
\end{document}
